title: Japan's Nikkei falls more than 2% on AI spending worries
title_zh: 日本日经指数因人工智能支出担忧而下跌超过 2%
summary: By Junko Fujita TOKYO, July 24 (Reuters) - Japan's Nikkei share average fell more than 2% on Friday, as a sharp decline in Google parent Alphabet shares spurred concerns about heavy AI spending.
summary_zh: 作者：Junko Fujita 东京，7 月 24 日（路透社）——日本日经指数周五下跌超过 2%，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 股价大幅下跌引发了人们对人工智能巨额支出的担忧。

title: Wall St falls as tech earnings spark AI spending worries
title_zh: 科技财报引发人工智能支出担忧，华尔街下跌
summary: STORY: Wall Street stocks plummeted on Thursday, with the Dow dropping about 1%, the S&P 500 shedding 1.2% and the Nasdaq tumbling more than 2%.The latest earnings results from large tech companies such as Alphabet and Tesla revived concerns about heavy AI spending, says Keith...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街股市周四暴跌，道琼斯指数下跌约 1%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.2%，纳斯达克指数下跌超过 2%。基思表示，Alphabet 和特斯拉等大型科技公司的最新财报再次引发了人们对人工智能巨额支出的担忧……

title: Goldman Offers Way to Trade AI Junk Bonds $250 Million at a Time
title_zh: 高盛提供一次交易 2.5 亿美元人工智能垃圾债券的方法
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and JPMorgan Chase & Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——高盛集团和摩根大通公司

title: Smart glasses are selling hot at National Vision, CEO ties it to the premium consumer
title_zh: 智能眼镜在National Vision热销，CEO将其与高端消费者联系起来
summary: Meta Platforms' (META) new Ray-Ban smart glasses are one of the fastest-selling products at eyeglass retailer National Vision (EYE).
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 的新款雷朋智能眼镜是眼镜零售商 National Vision (EYE) 销售最快的产品之一。

title: 'Magnificent 7' stocks erase $797 billion in market value in worst day since April 2025
title_zh: “Magnificent 7”股票市值蒸发 7970 亿美元，这是 2025 年 4 月以来最糟糕的一天
summary: The "Magnificent Seven" group of stocks suffered its steepest one-day decline since the tariff-driven market sell-off in April 2025.
summary_zh: “七巨头”股票遭遇了自 2025 年 4 月关税驱动的市场抛售以来最大幅度的单日跌幅。

title: 2 reasons why Microsoft belongs in your portfolio: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria
title_zh: Microsoft 属于您投资组合的 2 个理由：D.A.戴维森的吉尔·卢里亚
summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to explain why Microsoft (MSFT) is a top AI stock, arguing that its multi-year access to OpenAI’s technology and the rise of open-source models make owning a proprietary frontier model unnecessary.
summary_zh: DA戴维森公司的吉尔·卢里亚 (Gil Luria) 与雅虎财经的乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起解释了为什么微软 (MSFT) 是顶级人工智能股票，他认为微软多年来对 OpenAI 技术的使用以及开源模型的兴起使得拥有专有的前沿模型变得没有必要。

title: Could AMD's new Helios AI rack system push it to outperform Nvidia?
title_zh: AMD的新Helios AI机架系统能否推动其超越Nvidia？
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) unveiled its latest AI infrastructure product, the Helios rackscale systems for data centers.
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 推出了其最新的人工智能基础设施产品，即用于数据中心的 Helios 机架规模系统。

title: Google, Amazon, Meta, & Microsoft will spend 'unprecedented' $1T on AI capex in 2027: Analyst
title_zh: 分析师：谷歌、亚马逊、Meta 和微软将在 2027 年在人工智能资本支出上花费“前所未有”的 1T 美元
summary: Evercore ISI senior managing director and head of internet research, Mark Mahaney, discusses Alphabet's (GOOG, GOOGL) recent earnings results and his outlook for AI capex spending.
summary_zh: Evercore ISI 高级董事总经理兼互联网研究主管 Mark Mahaney 讨论了 Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）最近的盈利结果以及他对人工智能资本支出的展望。

title: How Tesla's robotaxi struggle is akin to the Apple vs. Google Maps rivalry
title_zh: 特斯拉的机器人出租车之争类似于苹果与谷歌地图的竞争
summary: RBC Capital Markets lead equity analyst on global autos, Tom Narayan, sits down with Julie Hyman on Market Catalysts to expand more on his takeaways from Tesla's (TSLA) latest earnings and where it may be facing the biggest problems in expanding its robotaxi business.
summary_zh: 加拿大皇家银行资本市场 (RBC Capital Markets) 全球汽车首席股票分析师汤姆·纳拉扬 (Tom Narayan) 在市场催化剂上与朱莉·海曼 (Julie Hyman) 进行了座谈，进一步阐述了他对特斯拉 (TSLA) 最新财报的看法，以及该公司在扩大机器...
